text: Quarter comparisons are December 2024, December 2025 and September 2025, annual comparisons are 2024 and 2025. The supplied 2024 reconciliation does not exclude its credit-loss provision, while the 2025 reconciliation does. The actual provisions are separately retained and are nonzero in both years.
